items.text: Seahawks placing first-round RB Jadarian Price on IR due to chest injury aggravated in practice; will miss minimum four weeks. Signed Velus Jones Jr. off PS.
items.why: Chest injury aggravated at practice this week.
items.implication: Out at least through Week 7; muddies SEA backfield further with Charbonnet return window open.
items.opportunity: Increased immediate role for backups (Wilson/Holani); Charbonnet stash priority.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday; returns from hip after missing Weeks 2-3. Possible snap limits speculated.
items.why: Full practices; McVay says looked sharp, off injury report.
items.implication: Startable WR1 but monitor early snaps/conditioning; Adams/others may see less.
items.opportunity: High target share expected vs PHI sans key Eagles defenders/pass-catchers.
items.conflict: Possible limits reduce ceiling slightly vs full workload.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT Sunday (sprained ankle). Confirmed across reports.
items.implication: Jordan Addison primary beneficiary in good home matchup vs MIA secondary.
items.opportunity: Addison target share spike; home vs borderline secondary.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) IN/returns in excellent spot: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring most in NFL (+7.3% DvP); Texans high implied total.
items.why: Full participant Friday, off report; elite matchup data.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 play; volume expected on return.
items.opportunity: High target/route share vs weak secondary.

items.text: Eagles without DeVonta Smith (hamstring), Dallas Goedert (knee), and Zack Baun vs Rams; situation getting worse for offense.
items.implication: Eagles pass game degraded; Hurts/others less efficient; elevated TEs (Ertz/Deguara) and remaining WRs.
items.opportunity: Higher shares for remaining pass-catchers; worse overall offense.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) QUESTIONABLE after LP-DNP-LP; already dealt with cracked rib this season.
items.why: Foot; practice pattern concerning with prior rib.
items.implication: Risky start; monitor Sunday status. If out, Johnston/others up.
items.opportunity: If active, still solid but volume risk.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (listed with others including AD Mitchell).
items.implication: Full RB snaps to backups (e.g. Braelon Allen saw 100% after exit prior).
MIA RB volume to Wright/others; low team total environment.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (left elbow) along with Rachaad White for Commanders.
items.implication: Backup QB; McLaurin Q compounds WAS issues in London.

items.text: Mike Evans (ribs) QUESTIONABLE/GTD but intends to play through it with padding/compression; painful but has done similar before. Shanahan: GTD.
items.why: Ribs; plans to play with protection.
items.implication: Monitor active; if OUT boosts Kittle further.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, TE/other WR routes up vs DEN.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yards every game.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches last week (outpaced W1+W2), RB5 utilization; NYG allows 5.1 YPC (3rd-most); double-digit target share every game.
HATE Omarion Hampton: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42% W3, only 13% 3rd down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).

LOVE Drake London (35%+ TS career w/ Penix, 43.5% last wk, NO soft vs WR TDs) and Garrett Wilson (36% TS prior no Mitchell, high efficiency vs CHI soft secondary). Also parlay lean Addison (JJ out) + Wilson.
items.why: QB/usage spikes + matchups; Mitchell out again for Wilson.
